summary: The test suite covers all major requirements (glob patterns, multi-label assignment, priority ordering, error handling, workflow structure, and act integration) and uses both unit tests (Pester) and integration tests (act harness). Test organization is clear with well-named test cases and good use of Pester fixtures. However, edge case coverage is limited: missing tests for null/empty paths, malformed priority values, very large inputs, complex overlapping patterns, and special characters in paths. The act harness includes only 3 representative test cases rather than exhaustive coverage. Tests are well-written and would catch basic regressions, but the rigor score is reduced due to gaps in boundary condition and error scenario testing.
